_comment: Curriculum roadmap for the daily 'new unit' scheduled task. Every run, the task builds ONE new unit for EACH of the 6 CEFR levels (not a rotation anymore). Each level's 'queue' is an ordered list of not-yet-built units — the task pops the first item off each level's queue, builds it, removes it from that queue, and bumps that level's nextUnitNumber. If a level's queue is empty on a given day, that level is skipped for the day (noted in the run summary) while the other levels still get built. If ALL 6 queues are empty, set _needsMoreRoadmap to true and stop.

queue.title: Opinion, Reason, and Example
queue.notes: Extend opinion + reason (because) with a simple example using 'for example'.

queue.title: Simple Overview Sentence
queue.notes: Write one sentence naming the single biggest pattern in the data before any detail.

queue.title: Comparing Four Categories
queue.notes: Describe four categories using ranking and contrast language together.

queue.title: Line Graph Fluctuation
queue.notes: Use 'fluctuated', 'peaked at', and 'levelled off' to describe an irregular trend.

queue.title: Table and Chart Synthesis
queue.notes: Combine a table and a described trend into one coherent synthesis paragraph.

queue.title: Complex Multi-Variable Report
queue.notes: Report on four or more categories with irregular, non-uniform trends using highly precise comparative language.
